gen-fs-gambarino-fs-spline-sans: Dramatic, ink-heavy Gambarino stems carry hairline crossbars that almost vanish. Spline Sans works beneath it, every stroke the same weight and its curves left open, so the drama stays up top.
gen-fs-karma-fs-merriweather-sans: Soft, tall and rounded: Karma has modest curve stress and a visible gap through each s. Merriweather Sans looks sturdy and large, its e opening clearly to the right, so whole paragraphs move along without tiring.
gen-fs-khand-newsreader: Khand packs crisp sans-serif letters tightly together, with no thick or thin strokes anywhere, including the w. Newsreader brings the quiet authority, built from restrained stroke contrast and open curves.
gen-fs-kohinoor-zerone-archivo: Kohinoor Zerone bends round letters like wire in one constant, pen-like line. Archivo adds editorial muscle beneath it, its sans-serif curves opening outward and its commanding x-height holding firm against all that wire.
gen-fs-kola-fs-chillax: Kola is bold and distinctive, with plain, unfussy letterforms. Chillax follows with casual, spaghetti-like lines and pen-lifted curves left open, a relaxed plain sans that is happiest over a few lines.
gen-fs-kola-plus-jakarta-sans: Loud, plain and unmistakable, Kola announces itself at once. Kola is best at making a statement, while Plus Jakarta Sans, built like bent tubing, is better suited to concise text.
gen-fs-new-title-cabin: Tall, bold and chain-linked, New Title looks built from fine links. Cabin then eases the reading, its bent-tubing sans forms and open terminals keeping paragraph after paragraph warm and unhurried.
gen-fs-new-title-roboto-slab: New Title locks its tall lowercase together like links in a fine chain. Roboto Slab, the slab-serif body, adds precise structure, with open throats and a middle zone that dominates each line.
gen-fs-oswald-fs-public-sans: Confident and tightly knit, Oswald packs its rows of text into a strong, compact block that holds attention. Public Sans loosens things with a hefty lowercase and broad, open counters.
gen-fs-oswald-fs-spline-sans: Oswald is confident and strong, its rows of text tightly knit. Spline Sans loosens the mood with approachable, plain sans lettering whose horizontals weigh exactly as much as its verticals.
